title: Terms of Use · Espaço Prelúdio
reviewNotice: Review notice. This document is in a testing phase and has not yet been validated by legal counsel specializing in digital health. Before any commercial operation, we recommend review by an attorney with experience in the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD), professional regulation (CFP/CFM) and consumer law.

s1.h: 1. Who we are and what we offer
s1.p1: Espaço Prelúdio ("Platform") is a technology service that connects healthcare professionals — psychologists, physicians, social workers, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nutritionists, dentists, physical education professionals and other categories duly registered with a regulated professional council — to their patients, through end-to-end encrypted videoconferencing, electronic health records and clinical organization tools.
s1.p2: The Platform is operated by [Legal Entity to be defined], registered under CNPJ no. [to be defined], headquartered at [address] (hereinafter "we", "our" or "Espaço Prelúdio"). For contact: contato@preludiojogos.com.
s1.p3: The Platform is a technology tool. We are not a clinic, we do not provide clinical care nor are we responsible for the content, technical adequacy or outcome of consultations — that responsibility belongs exclusively to the professional hired by the patient.

s2.li1a: Natural person aged 18 or older with active and regular registration in a professional council (CRP, CRM, or other competent body according to the profession).
s2.li1b: Authorized, under the terms of CFP Resolution no. 11/2018 and other applicable resolutions, to provide care through technological means.
s2.li1c: Responsible for keeping their registration data up to date and for all information entered in records under their ownership.
s2.li2a: Natural person aged 18 or older. Minors may only be treated with the express consent of a legal guardian and under the clinical judgment of the professional.
s2.li2b: Prior acceptance of these Terms of Use and the Data Processing Policy.
s2.li2c: Minimum technical capacity: device with camera, microphone, updated browser and internet connection.

s3.p1: Registration requires truthful information. The user is responsible for:
s3.li1: Maintaining the confidentiality of the password and the seed phrase (recovery phrase). By cryptographic design, we cannot recover your notes if you lose both.
s3.li2: Immediately notifying us in case of misuse of the account.
s3.li3: For professionals: ensuring that their professional council registration remains active throughout use of the Platform.
s3.p2: Each account is personal and non-transferable. Credential sharing is strictly prohibited.

s4.p1: The clinical relationship is established exclusively between professional and patient. It is up to the professional to:
s4.li1a: Assess the adequacy of online care for the clinical case, in accordance with CFP Resolution no. 11/2018 or equivalent rules of their profession.
s4.li1b: Maintain professional secrecy and the custody of the record for the legal period (minimum of 20 years for professionals governed by the CFP, under CFP Resolution no. 1/2019).
s4.li1c: Collect informed consent from the patient before treatment.
s4.li1d: Issue clinical documents (certificates, prescriptions, declarations) in accordance with applicable regulations and with ICP-Brasil standard digital signature when required.
s4.p2: It is up to the patient to:
s4.li2a: Verify in advance the registration of the contracted professional.
s4.li2b: Be in a private and safe environment during the consultation.
s4.li2c: Not record the session without express authorization from the professional, and vice versa.

s5.p: It is prohibited to use the Platform to:
s5.li1: Practice illegal exercise of the profession or pose as a qualified professional when not.
s5.li2: Share illegal, discriminatory, violent content or content that violates third-party rights.
s5.li3: Attempt to interfere with, decrypt, reverse engineer or compromise the security of the Platform.
s5.li4: Carry out automated data collection, scraping, or unauthorized bot use.
s5.li5: Capture, record or retransmit the content of third-party consultations.

s6.p1: The Platform is offered on a best-effort basis. There may be maintenance windows, connection instabilities and occasional unavailability arising from external factors (carriers, browsers, third-party infrastructure). We are not responsible for:
s6.li1: Equipment or connection failures of the user.
s6.li2: Content, technical quality or clinical effects of treatment.
s6.li3: Loss of notes due to simultaneous forgetting of password and seed phrase.
s6.li4: Acts of third parties constituting fortuitous event or force majeure.
s6.p2: In a situation of clinical emergency or imminent risk to life, the patient must immediately contact the public emergency service (SAMU 192, Polícia 190 or Corpo de Bombeiros 193). The Platform is not suitable for emergency care.

s7.p1: The Espaço Prelúdio brand, logo, interface, texts, code, layouts and graphic elements are protected by copyright and industrial property rights. Total or partial reproduction is prohibited without express written authorization.
s7.p2: The clinical content produced by users (notes, records, uploaded files) remains the exclusive property of the user who produced it. We do not access this content, as detailed in the Data Processing Policy.

s8.p1: [During the testing phase, the Platform is free.] When charges apply, the contracted plan, amounts and payment methods will be displayed before contracting. Refund, cancellation and renewal will follow the rules described on the plan page and the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code (Law no. 8,078/1990) when applicable.
s8.p2: We do not issue tax documents on behalf of the professional. The financial relationship between professional and patient (fees, receipts, invoices) is external to the Platform and the exclusive responsibility of the professional.

s9.p1: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that:
s9.li1: Violate these Terms of Use or the Data Processing Policy.
s9.li2: Show well-founded evidence of fraud, illegal exercise of the profession or harmful practice.
s9.li3: Receive a judicial or administrative order to that effect.
s9.p2: The user may terminate their account at any time. Data deletion requests follow the procedure described in the Data Processing Policy (section on data subject rights).

s10.p: We may update this Policy to reflect changes in the service, in legislation or in market practices. Relevant changes will be communicated at least 15 days in advance by email or notice on the Platform itself. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the new version.

s11.p: This Policy is governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. The jurisdiction of the District of [to be defined] is hereby elected to settle disputes, with express waiver of any other, however privileged it may be — except for the jurisdictions defined by the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code.

s12.p: Questions, complaints and requests: contato@preludiojogos.com. For specific data protection issues, see the channels indicated in the Data Processing Policy.
